title: Z.ai documentation identified GLM-5.2 as its latest model
summary: On 2026-06-14, the dated record linked Z.ai DevPack documentation for the latest model under the GLM-5.2 project line. This is a material documentation and availability milestone, but the post and linked documentation were not researched, so no release details, capabilities, or access terms are asserted.
